premises.text: Stigma, healthcare distrust, and long clinic wait lists block people from getting depression treatment
premises.evidence_span: One reason is the social stigma that exists around it

premises.text: Antidepressant care is trial-and-error with roughly 40% first-line response over months
premises.evidence_span: a treatment model that revolves around trial and error, where you're prescribed an antidepressant, you only have a 40% chance of responding to it

premises.text: Existing DNA, mRNA, and protein approaches are inadequate biomarkers for depression care
premises.evidence_span: The big problem in mental health care is that there are no good biomarkers that exist today

premises.text: Circular RNA biomarkers are stable, predictive, and measurable in blood
premises.evidence_span: Circular RNAs are a biomarker. They're stable, predictive, and can be measured in bodily fluids, including your blood

premises.text: Blood-sample circRNA qPCR plus an analytical pipeline can diagnose depression and predict medication response
premises.evidence_span: we use a process called quantitative, circRNA-specific quantitative PCR. We use this to measure the expression levels of the circular RNAs

premises.text: Primary care, telemedicine, and urgent care are the channels for the product
premises.evidence_span: There are three channels that we see our product easily going into the market. Primary care, telemedicine, and urgent care

value.text: Precision medicine that improves depression diagnosis and treatment outcomes
value.evidence_span: help clinicians provide precision medicine leading to improved patient outcomes

secondary_value.text: Biological basis for depression helps remove stigma
secondary_value.evidence_span: This helps remove the stigma that revolves around depression by giving it a biological basis
